name: Seven-spot Ladybug
note: Seven spots. I counted twice. Bruno counted nine and refuses to discuss it.
stamps: Third one this week. Bruno now insists they're following him. They are following the aphids, Bruno.
Ten ladybugs. I've named them all. Nine are called Dot. The tenth is called Also Dot.

name: Honeybee
note: Works harder than anyone in Bramblewick. Present company included. Especially present company.
stamps: Back again. She visits the same flowers in the same order every day. Rufus calls that 'a routine'. I call it rude to copy.
Ten visits. I think she recognises your farm now. Bees remember faces. Mine she pretends not to.

name: Garden Snail
note: Moves slower than Rufus on a Monday. An admirable commitment to the bit.
stamps: It has crossed one plot since Tuesday. I've started cheering. Quietly. Snails startle.
Ten sightings. I've begun to suspect it's the same snail, simply very well travelled. Slowly.

name: Leaf Caterpillar
note: Eats its own body weight in lettuce daily. Juniper is taking notes, which worries me.
stamps: Third sighting, and it's visibly larger. So is the hole in your lettuce. Science has costs.
Ten. One of them will be a butterfly soon. I'll pretend I'm not emotional about it.

name: Cabbage White
note: Elegant, plain, and entirely too fond of lettuce. Like Goldie.
stamps: Another one. They flutter like they've forgotten something. Goldie says that's her every morning.
Ten cabbage whites. My notebook is mostly lettuce stains and admiration now.

name: Bumblebee
note: Aerodynamically impossible. Flies anyway. Pip says this is her whole personality.
stamps: Third bumblebee, and still no one has explained the physics to it. I won't be the one.
Ten. It hums in a slightly flat B. Juniper wants to tune it. I've told her no.

name: Shield Beetle
note: Built like a tiny knight. Smells like a tiny knight who has been to war.
stamps: Third shield beetle. It held its ground against Moss. Moss lost. Moss is fine.
Ten sightings. If they ever form an army, I'd like it noted I was always respectful.

name: Blue Dragonfly
note: Hovers like it owns the place. Ziggy has tried to sell me one. Twice.
stamps: It caught a gnat mid-air while I was sketching it. Show-off. Beautiful, but a show-off.
Ten blue dragonflies. Ziggy has offered me a 'very fair price' for my notes. Still no.

name: Golden Ladybug
note: Rare. Lucky, according to Goldie. Unremarkable, according to science. I am keeping it anyway.
stamps: A third golden ladybug. Goldie says I'm due a lucky streak. My pencil just broke.
Ten golden ladybugs. Either luck is real or your farm is. I'm choosing your farm.

name: Monarch Butterfly
note: Travels thousands of miles every year. Tobias managed one trip in forty. Just saying.
stamps: Another monarch, resting on its long trip. I gave it a crumb of encouragement. Metaphorically.
Ten monarchs. Your farm is on their map now. That's a bigger honour than any ribbon.

name: Tiger Caterpillar
note: Striped as a warning. The warning is: I am adorable. It works on Moss every time.
stamps: Third tiger caterpillar. Moss tried to herd it. It was not herded.
Ten sightings. I've stopped warning people about the stripes. Nobody listens. They just say 'aww'.

name: Ruby Dragonfly
note: Faster than the eye can follow. I sketched it from memory and a strong suspicion.
stamps: Third ruby dragonfly. I sketched one wing this time before it left. Progress.
Ten. I finally have a complete drawing, assembled from ten partial ones. Like a quilt. A fast quilt.

name: Stag Beetle
note: Enormous jaws, gentle nature. Bruno says it reminds him of himself. Nobody has argued.
stamps: Third stag beetle. Two of them squared off over a pumpkin. Bruno took sides. Loudly.
Ten. I gave this one a tiny bow. Bruno says that's undignified. Bruno is jealous.

name: Luna Moth
note: Lives one week and never eats. Rufus asked if it was a miller. I laughed. He did not.
stamps: Another luna moth. It sat on your fence like a lantern someone forgot to light.
Ten luna moths. Rufus has stopped asking if they mill things. Growth, for both of us.

name: Purple Emperor
note: Iridescent, imperious, and very hard to impress. We understand each other.
stamps: Third emperor. It landed on my hat. I have never been so honoured or so still.
Ten purple emperors. It finally let me sketch it from the front. We're friends now. Practically.

name: Violet Snail
note: Purple shell. No idea why. I have written four papers on it and still have no idea why.
stamps: Third violet snail. Still purple. Still no idea why. Paper five is underway.
Ten. I've decided the shell is purple because it can be. That's the whole paper now. It's my best one.

name: Golden Moth
note: Tobias drew this moth in the margin of his almanac in 1979. I told him he'd imagined it. I owe him an apology. And a pie.
stamps: It came back. Tobias wrote 'told you so' in the margin of my notes. In ink.
Ten golden moths. Tobias and I watched one together from your fence. Neither of us said anything. Neither of us needed to.
